limits: Owns the complete 32-byte cdecl2 original table dispatcher, with its unsigned loop and every null, empty and reversed-bound branch; no fixed count, table snapshot or startup prefix replaces it.

Full integer source input/output masks 0x7ff retain live EAX and flags despite semantic void; conservative preserve_mask zero avoids an unproven transitive register invariant across mutable runtime-selected table roots.
The genuine CALL EAX child has cdecl0/RET0, ECX and all selected integer state inherited, child ESP equal to dispatcher entry ESP minus 12, and real return PC 0x4a5896.

All 149 nonnull original roots from the four actual caller-selected startup and exit tables run whole original source; table-null and bound variations are case inputs, and internal callbacks cannot be env.stub stand-ins.
Runtime table words are read when each iteration reaches them; callee effects may change later table entries. No table copy or cached future root is permitted.
Approved CRT memory-service v1 fixtures and physical Windows imports require coherent ownership and memory effects; they do not establish native CRT or Windows acceptance.
Original calloc 0x4adf50 remains whole original code including HeapAlloc or small-block paths; it is not an additional allocator fixture.

Dynamic global callbacks at 0x52e9f8 and 0x541138 and loaded function pointers must retain genuine original identities. Unsupported resolution and nonreturning physical failure paths must stop honestly.

RaiseException cannot be fabricated as a successful return. Guest exception closure, x87/SSE state certification, finite native root election and complete startup/gameplay acceptance are separate unfinished work.
